sequences.name: Premium Safari: Small-Group First Look
sequences.goal: Build anticipation for small-group safari and convert Premium Adventurers via priority early access
sequences.rationale: Safari search is up 37% YoY with 'small group safari' breaking out, and 61.5% of Premium members show affinity. Sends use Tuesdays at 07:00 and are offset from the snow sequence so the segment's 2/week cap is never exceeded.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Why small-group safaris are having a moment
emails.preheader: Fewer vehicles, closer encounters, unhurried mornings in the bush.
emails.creativeDirection: Full-bleed golden-hour hero of a single open-sided vehicle facing an elephant herd. Short editorial layout with three pull-quotes on what small-group means. One quiet CTA button.
emails.rationale: 'Small group safari' is a breakout query and 61.5% of the segment shows affinity; lead with story before the ask.

emails.subject: Your first look at small-group safari departures
emails.preheader: Premium members see new safari dates before the wider list.
emails.creativeDirection: Dark, elegant layout with a lodge-at-dusk image and a simple three-row departure teaser module. A 'Premium early access' badge in the header.
emails.rationale: Early access fits the segment's aspirational tone and above-average 8.9% click rate; pre-holiday timing catches planning intent.

emails.subject: A dawn game drive, hour by hour
emails.preheader: What a morning in the savanna really feels like.
emails.creativeDirection: Timeline-style story with five sunrise-to-brunch photos and a short guide quote. Soft CTA at the bottom plus a link to the priority list.
emails.rationale: Seasonality index of 0.93 means steady, not peak, demand; story content keeps interest warm without pressure.

emails.subject: Start the year with a safari on the calendar
emails.preheader: Priority access to small-group safari departures for Premium members.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean new-year hero: sunrise over the plains with a calendar overlay. Single hero offer block, minimal copy.
emails.rationale: Resolution week lifts planning intent; pair it with the early-access offer.

emails.subject: Small-group safari: your priority window
emails.preheader: Secure your place before availability opens to everyone.
emails.creativeDirection: Split layout: left a guest-style testimonial placeholder, right a close-up of a leopard in a tree. Clear single CTA.
emails.rationale: Final reminder to non-converters, timed after MLK weekend and well inside the cap.

sequences.name: Premium Snow: Alps Early Access and Lodge Packages
sequences.goal: Convert winter-intent Premium Adventurers through Alps Ski Week early access and snowshoe lodge packages
sequences.rationale: The snow seasonality index is 1.55, the highest in the plan, and 'snowshoe lodge package' is a breakout query. The Alps Ski Week early access launch on 2026-11-20 anchors the sequence. Sends are offset from the safari sequence to respect the 2/week cap.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: The snowshoe lodge escape, explained
emails.preheader: Quiet trails by day, a fireside lodge by night.
emails.creativeDirection: Hero of a stone lodge glowing at dusk with snowshoers on a ridge. Three-step 'how a lodge package works' graphic.
emails.rationale: 'Snowshoe lodge package' is a breakout query and the seasonality index is high.

emails.subject: Alps Ski Week early access opens Friday
emails.preheader: Premium members get in first. Here is what to expect.
emails.creativeDirection: Panoramic Alpine ridge at sunrise with a countdown block to 20 Nov. Concise bullet list of the week's highlights, one bold CTA.
emails.rationale: Heads-up three days ahead of the 2026-11-20 launch; 53.8% segment affinity for snow sports.

emails.subject: Ski or snowshoe? Build your winter week
emails.preheader: Pair mountain days with a lodge stay in one package.
emails.creativeDirection: Side-by-side card layout comparing ski and snowshoe days, each with an image and a 'pair with lodge' tag.
emails.rationale: Peak seasonality (1.55) and the breakout lodge-package query support a bundle framing. No prices are cited.

emails.subject: Alps Ski Week: early access is still open
emails.preheader: Plan the trip before the holiday rush settles in.
emails.creativeDirection: Bright bluebird-day powder shot, a short reminder module and a 'Premium early access' badge.
emails.rationale: Reminder for people who did not act at launch; snow affinity and the launch anchor justify it.

emails.subject: Mid-winter, mountain-ready: your next snow trip
emails.preheader: Snowshoe lodge stays and Alps weeks, curated for you.
emails.creativeDirection: Editorial grid of three winter trips with moody dusk photography. Minimal text and one CTA.
emails.rationale: Winter demand stays elevated into January (1.55 index); a softer story email closes the sequence.

sequences.name: Mindful Cycling: Bikepacking Know-How
sequences.goal: Educate Mindful Explorers on bikepacking and gravel tours to build consideration ahead of spring
sequences.rationale: Bikepacking search is up 54% YoY and 65.4% of the segment shows cycling affinity. Seasonality is low at 0.48, so educational content stories fit better than a hard sell. Sends are Mondays at 08:00.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Bikepacking 101: what to pack and why
emails.preheader: A simple checklist for your first multi-day ride.
emails.creativeDirection: Flat-lay of a bikepacking kit with numbered callouts. Checklist layout, plain and practical.
emails.rationale: Bikepacking interest is up 54% and the segment is educational in tone.

emails.subject: How to choose a gravel bike tour
emails.preheader: Terrain, daily distance and support: what to compare.
emails.creativeDirection: Comparison table graphic with three tour styles, each paired with a terrain photo. Calm, uncluttered, no promo banners.
emails.rationale: 'Gravel bike tour' is a breakout query. Sending on Cyber Monday with practical value stands out from promo noise.

emails.subject: Plan your spring ride from the couch
emails.preheader: Winter is route-planning season. Here is how to start.
emails.creativeDirection: Cozy desk scene with a map and a bike in the background. Four-step planning guide with small icons.
emails.rationale: Seasonality is low at 0.48, so frame winter as planning time rather than riding time.

emails.subject: Map your 2027 riding calendar
emails.preheader: Three trip formats to help you pick the right one.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean calendar graphic with ride-season bands and three trip cards beneath. Bright new-year palette.
emails.rationale: Resolution week brings a planning mindset; the bikepacking trend supports the topic.

emails.subject: Gravel or road? Pick the tour that fits
emails.preheader: A plain-language guide to terrain, pace and logistics.
emails.creativeDirection: Split-screen photo, gravel track on one side and road climb on the other, with a short pros/cons list.
emails.rationale: 'Gravel bike tour' is breaking out, so a decision-aid closes the sequence.

sequences.name: Family Camping: Cozy Winter Bundles
sequences.goal: Introduce winter and heated-tent camping and drive interest in camping bundles for Family Getaways
sequences.rationale: Winter camping search is up 26.5% YoY, 'heated tent camping' is breaking out, and 58.1% of the segment shows camping affinity. Sends use the segment's Sunday 19:00 slot in a playful tone, with no more than one email per week.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 40 segment members (8%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Yes, you can camp in winter (and it's cozy)
emails.preheader: Heated tents, hot cocoa and starry skies. Here's how it works.
emails.creativeDirection: Illustrated, playful header of a glowing tent in the snow with string lights. Three quick 'myth vs reality' tiles.
emails.rationale: 'Heated tent camping' is breaking out; a fun myth-busting intro matches the playful tone.

emails.subject: The camp-out bundle, built for the whole crew
emails.preheader: Trip plus gear picks in one easy package. Cyber Monday is tomorrow.
emails.creativeDirection: Bright flat-lay of tent, lanterns, mugs and a trip card, with a 'bundle' ribbon. Modular grid, big tappable tiles.
emails.rationale: Black Friday weekend (1.8x demand boost) is a natural slot for a bundle; no discount percentages are claimed.

emails.subject: Cozy campsite ideas for holiday break
emails.preheader: Heated-tent getaways your crew will actually want to join.
emails.creativeDirection: Warm lantern-lit tent interior with a checklist overlay. A 'pick your campsite vibe' card carousel.
emails.rationale: Plan ahead for the school-holiday window with packaged trips; camping seasonality is 1.09.

emails.subject: New year, new campfire stories
emails.preheader: Easy winter camping ideas for the months ahead.
emails.creativeDirection: Playful hand-drawn campfire illustration with a 'first-timer tips' list. Snappy, scannable.
emails.rationale: A lighter story email after the holidays keeps interest warm. Winter camping search is up 26.5%.

emails.subject: Pack it, pitch it, love it: camping bundles
emails.preheader: Choose a trip and gear bundle for your next outdoor weekend.
emails.creativeDirection: Bold three-tile bundle comparison with cheerful illustrations and a simple 'what's included' list. One main CTA.
emails.rationale: Closes the sequence with the primary bundle offer; 58.1% segment affinity.

sequences.name: Deal Seekers Cycling: Value Offers
sequences.goal: Convert Deal Seekers on cycling tours with clear, no-fluff offers timed to Black Friday and Cyber Monday
sequences.rationale: Bikepacking interest is up 54% YoY and 53.8% of Deal Seekers show cycling affinity. The segment responds to discounts (7.9% click rate) and tolerates up to 3 emails per week, but low seasonality (0.48) argues for restraint. No discount percentages are stated because none were provided.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Cycling tours: what's coming this month
emails.preheader: Gravel and bikepacking trips, plus a heads-up on holiday offers.
emails.creativeDirection: Simple, text-forward layout with a single gravel-road hero and three trip links. Plain headline, no gimmicks.
emails.rationale: A short pre-sale heads-up sets expectations. 'Gravel bike tour' is a breakout query.

emails.subject: Black Friday: cycling tour offers are live
emails.preheader: Gravel and bikepacking trips. Terms inside, no fine-print games.
emails.creativeDirection: High-contrast banner with an 'Offer live' label, then a clean three-trip list with 'what's included' lines. Offer terms are set by merchandising and shown plainly.
emails.rationale: Black Friday has the top demand boost (1.8x) and the segment is deal-driven; the offer's specific terms are left to merchandising.

emails.subject: Cyber Monday: last day for cycling tour offers
emails.preheader: Gravel and bikepacking trips. Offers end tonight.
emails.creativeDirection: Minimal reminder with a countdown bar and the same three trips. Short copy, one CTA.
emails.rationale: Cyber Monday (1.6x boost) follows two days after Black Friday, within the segment's 3/week cap.

emails.subject: Gravel tours worth booking for spring
emails.preheader: A quick comparison of what you get on each trip.
emails.creativeDirection: Compact value table comparing three tours by days, terrain and what's included. No imagery beyond a thin banner.
emails.rationale: A value-focused comparison suits no-nonsense buyers during the low-seasonality winter period (0.48 index).

emails.subject: New-year cycling trips, straight to the point
emails.preheader: Bikepacking and gravel tours to book now for the season ahead.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean list of featured trips, each with a one-line value summary and a book button.
emails.rationale: Resolution week (1.5x boost) lifts planning; a deal-oriented list suits the segment.

emails.subject: Cycling tour bundles: ride more, plan once
emails.preheader: Combine a tour and gear in one booking.
emails.creativeDirection: Two-column 'what's in the bundle' layout with a gravel bike photo and a clear list. A firm CTA.
emails.rationale: A bundle option for late-window conversion; 53.8% affinity and a breakout query.
